result.citation_basis: § 158-2: O080 and D034 (title of ordinance); Ord. No. B-781: O080; adopted 7-9-2025: O080 and D034
result.official_quote: Landlords who rent any residential dwelling unit (defined as any primary residence excluding medical/long-term care or detention facilities) in the City of Hoboken are prohibited from price fixing using algorithmic pricing.
result.note: The ordinance number B-781 from the official code (O080) was added in place of the lawyer's 'ordinance adopted July 9, 2025', and the section stays § 158-2 because the ordinance's '§ 154-8' heading conflicts with its own title and the codified section.
